routes.name: R_ET_EXPLICIT
routes.description: Explicit double commutators and normal-kernel intersections replace the density-to-membership passage; a phase-ring congruence lemma replaces both global unit arguments.

C9000018.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 018 (The Margulis–Platonov conjecture over global fields.; papers: The Margulis–Platonov conjecture over global function fields; The Margulis–Platonov conjecture over number fields; Lean status: UNFORMALIZED (No Lean proof in openai/math)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

C_ET_EXACT.statement: Actual single-block upper and lower shears and exact transitivity under all original hypotheses.

C_ET_GENERAL_BLOCK.statement: The strengthened exact supported-shear theorem for any finite disjoint parameter tuple over any quadratic global field, without parity, conjugacy, or degree-six restrictions on the block setting.

C_ET_SEPARATE.statement: The separable degree-two slope map produces a triangular separator at any selected block, retaining the characteristic-two restriction.

C_ET_PHASE_RING.statement: A finite-quotient subring of the phase ring supplies congruence units without Dirichlet's theorem or divisor-class finiteness.

C_ET_KERNEL_WORD.statement: An explicit double commutator kills one block, and exact commutators combine all other-block kernels without density.

C_ET_NORMAL.statement: An affine commutator extracts an actual nonidentity shear inside a normal subgroup.

C_ET_ADDITIVE.statement: The exact abstract additive group generated by U(k) is D over either global field.

C_ET_ACTION.statement: Nonzero supported increments and exact additive generation force transitivity on nonzero pairs.

C_ET_FORMAL_CORE.statement: Universal matrix and normal-subgroup identities and exact additive amplification in Lean.

C_NF_SHEARS.statement: Number-field lem:chars-pure-shears under its original hypotheses.

C_NF_DIFFERENCE.statement: Number-field prop:chars-difference, using the original pair-invariance and Sylvester construction.

C_NF_PAIR.statement: Original number-field well-definedness, Sylvester, pair-invariance, and evaluation identities, outside the selected transitivity proof.

C_NF_MAIN.statement: The number-field manuscript's thm:main with its full original quantifiers.

C_NF_REMAINING.statement: The remaining number-field character-continuity, recurrence, finite-group, and structural reductions; not certified by this mission.

C_FF_TRANSITIVITY.statement: Function-field char:transitivity and its difference identity under the original hypotheses.

C_FF_PAIR.statement: Original function-field well-definedness, Sylvester, pair-invariance, and evaluation identities, outside the selected transitivity proof.

C_FF_MAIN.statement: The function-field manuscript's thm:main with its full original quantifiers, including characteristic two.

C_FF_REMAINING.statement: The remaining function-field character-continuity, recurrence, finite-group, and structural reductions; not certified by this mission.
